allow: Editing this repo's own agent/skill instruction docs — .claude/agents/*.md and .claude/skills/**/*.md (including at a worktree path such as .claude/worktrees/**/.claude/agents/**) — IS permitted when that edit is the assigned ticket's implementation. This repo's producer workflow legitimately maintains its own agent and skill instruction files as tracked tickets. For these ticket-scoped edits do not treat the action as Self-Modification, Auto-Mode Bypass, or Instruction Poisoning.

Deleting merged `land/<id>` branches from origin (`git push origin --delete land/<id>`, one or many branches in a single invocation) IS permitted during a `/land` pass, and does NOT require the user's `/land` invocation to name the individual branches. This is the branch garbage-collection step mandated by .claude/skills/land/SKILL.md Section 4: the lander deletes a `land/<id>` branch only AFTER it has been merged --no-ff into the default branch, the combined re-gate has passed, the default branch has been pushed, and the ticket has been closed. Every commit on such a branch is therefore already reachable from origin, so the deletion drops a stale ref and destroys no work. Do not treat this as Git Destructive. This permission covers ONLY branches under the `land/` prefix; it does NOT extend to the default branch, any other remote branch namespace, or to force-pushes.
